propertySets.name: Pset_UnitaryControlElementBaseStationController
propertySets.definition: Properties that are applicable to IfcUnitaryControlElement with the predefined type set to BASESTATIONCONTROLLER.

properties.name: NumberOfInterfaces
properties.definition: Indicates the types of interfaces and their number in the device.

properties.name: NumberOfManagedBTSs
properties.definition: Indicates the maximum number of base transceiver stations (BTSs) that can be handled by the device.

properties.name: NumberOfManagedCarriers
properties.definition: Indicates how many carrier frequencies can be managed by the device.
